name: driven Jaynes-Cummings resonator at high power (bright state, punch-out)
question: Does the drive strength cross a qubit-dependent threshold of the Jaynes-Cummings bistability (threshold write), and with which law?
assumptions: semiclassical Maxwell-Bloch image of Bishop 2010 eqs. 1, 8, 10 in units of kappa; detuning delta = 100 kappa and g = 20 kappa (scaled down from g/kappa = 200 to keep the equations tractable); critical points xi_C1 = (delta kappa)^{3/2}/(3^{3/4} g^2) ~ 1.1, xi_C2 = g/sqrt 2 ~ 14
vacuum noise kappa/8 on all variables
